name: Satomura Haruka
source:
Satomura Haruka is Satomura Momiji's younger sister. She was killed in an accident a few years before the events of Fortissimo//Akkord:Bsusvier, which traumatized Momiji. Later on, her soul became Momiji's magic and magical weapon in the battle of Ragnarök.

[Taken from [url=http://fortissimo.wikia.com/wiki/Haruka_Satomura]fortissimo Wikia[/url]]
